clips.title: The story
paras: Dungar Longdrink sends armor from Stormwind to the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill. Osric's Crate crosses Elwynn and Westfall by gryphon, carrying supplies to defenders under pressure.

Westfall is slipping from the kingdom's grasp. Defias bandits, ravenous gnolls, and mechanical harvest reapers threaten the land. Overland supply routes face harassment, and roads are dangerous for solitary wagons. The flight master network offers a crucial lifeline. Osric, an armorer in Stormwind's Old Town, prepared a heavy crate of armor for the battered volunteers of the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill.

Gryphons are loyal, well-trained beasts, but travel across the lands depends on established familiarity. Dungar Longdrink explains that gryphons instinctively know how to return to their capital roost in Stormwind. To carry a rider to a remote outpost, though, they need the traveler to have met its flight master in person. You have already checked in with Thor at Sentinel Hill, opening the skies over the frontier to rapid travel.

At Sentinel Hill, Quartermaster Lewis receives the crate. He is the officer tasked with outfitting Gryan Stoutmantle's volunteer force, and he sets to work distributing the armor among the frontier defenders. For Sentinel Hill, reliable aerial contact with the capital can mean the difference between holding the line and being overrun by the Defias Brotherhood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor. If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.
That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.
You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall. Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're back from Stormwind? Did Osric send the armor?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you brought the armor! We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.
Thank you, friend. Your efforts have been a great help to us. And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
